title: Pilobol.us P3-05: import the 21 Git items into the new CMS (dry run, apply) and byte-diff export fidelity
description:
## Goal
Import the 21 tracked Git items into the NEW CMS backend (dry run, review, apply) and run the one-time byte-diff sanity check that export reproduces the Git files and a rebuilt site.

## Context (FACT, offline run 2026-10-06 with develop 4a423c3, fake client)
- Source = git archive of AnthusAI/Pilobol.us origin/main web/content (tracked files only): 21 .md (10 articles, a-fungus-among-us, 3 drafts, 7 effects pages), 65 asset files. Never use the local checkout or the two generated listing pages.
- Expected: errors 0, created 21, published 18, drafts 3 (--draft-dirs drafts=articles), mediaUploaded 13 (3.1 MB), readerOwnedAssets 56 (stay in the repo), aliases 0, redirects 0. Export: 18 items, 12 media. Reader build from export + no-clobber asset overlay = 94 files identical to the Git-built site.
- Auth for the operator CLI: papyrus auth refresh-jwt reads the new backend's PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET from SSM (a secret read: Ryan's yes; never print).
- Bodies are stored verbatim, so article text is unchanged.

## Exact steps
1. Scratch clone, git archive source, venv with the pinned papyrus-newsroom[markus,newsroom]; npx ampx generate outputs for the NEW app main (public ids).
2. Ryan yes: mint JWT. Dry run: papyrus content import-markus --content-dir <src> --draft-dirs drafts=articles --dry-run --json; review the numbers above with Ryan.
3. Ryan yes: --apply --bucket <new media bucket>; re-run: created 0, updated 0, mediaUnchanged 13.
4. papyrus content export-published --out scratch/export --clean; diff-trees.py (sanity ticket) export vs source .md files and a scratch build from export vs a scratch build from Git: identical. Delete scratch/.env.

## Acceptance checks
Numbers match; second apply no-op; byte diff clean; drafts not in export without --drafts.

## Rollback
Re-import is idempotent; the backend is disposable (nothing depends on it yet).

## Risks
Do not edit content in the CMS before this check (re-import never overwrites CMS edits).

## Needs Ryan
JWT mint yes; apply yes.

## Common rules (Phase 3 Pilobol.us, simplified plan v2)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (PR AnthusAI/Papyrus#128). Ryan 2026-10-06: Pilobol.us is PRE-PRODUCTION, Git history is the rollback, HARD CUTOVER: no soak, no Git freeze, no dual Git/CMS build path, no parity gate, brief downtime is fine. New Amplify apps are created from the template; the old apps and the old EMPTY backend are retired at the end.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan (or on his explicit yes).
- Never build in /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us (its build rewrites content): use a fresh clone or a worktree.
- Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo: feature branch + PR, never push to its main. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus only run kbs.
- Keep article text verbatim (the importer already does; narration hashes depend on it). The Auritus embed is origin-locked to the site key's origin; the production origin stays pilobol.us, so nothing changes there (narration will not play on temporary amplifyapp.com URLs: expected).
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.

comments.text: Dry run 2026-10-06 (no writes; fresh clone of Pilobol.us main 86d3ce3, papyrus-newsroom[markus]==1.0.0.dev11 in py3.12 venv, SigV4 via AWS_PROFILE=legacy, endpoint/bucket of new backend via a scratch amplify_outputs.json, PAPYRUS_ROOT): papyrus ops content import-markus --content-dir web/content --draft-dirs drafts=articles --dry-run --json => ok true, created 21, updated 0, unchanged 0, skippedEditedInCms 0, published 18, mediaUploaded 13, mediaUnchanged 0, readerOwnedAssets 56, notInSource 0, errors []. Matches expected numbers. Media bucket amplify-dv0pdx67fk80m-mai-papyrusmediabucket0dab24-onja3prevkp2. Scratch clone and venv deleted. NOT applied; awaiting Ryan review.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Apply 2026-10-06 (Ryan yes) to new backend dv0pdx67fk80m, SigV4 via AWS_PROFILE=legacy, papyrus-newsroom 1.0.0.dev12, source Pilobol.us main 8210c6f (web/content identical to 86d3ce3). Dry run: ok, created 21, published 18, mediaUploaded 13, errors []. Apply (dev12 CLI has no --apply flag; writes by default, --dry-run previews): ok, created 21, updated 0, published 18, mediaUploaded 13, readerOwnedAssets 56, errors [], no rebuild triggered. Re-run: NOT a pure no-op: created 0, published 0, mediaUploaded 0, mediaUnchanged 13, but updated 12, unchanged 9. Cause: _media_differs compares the MediaAsset metadata JSON string; AppSync returns it with reordered keys (sha256 first), so every item with media (12) counts as changed and its identical MediaAsset rows are re-upserted. Harmless (no duplicates, no S3 writes), package bug to fix. Read-only checks: DynamoDB Item 21 (18 published, 3 draft), PublishedItem 18 (no drafts), MediaAsset 13; S3 media/ has 13 objects; spot check author-is-elon Item and PublishedItem have bodyMarkus (13614 chars); bodyIr absent (0) as expected. export-published --auth guest: 18 items, 18 .md all byte-identical to source. Reader build from export (reader/build.py) vs Git build (web/build_via_papyrus.py --content web/content): 94 files each, diff-trees.py (PR #44) 0 differences. Scratch clone, venv, outputs deleted.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closed: import applied (21 items, 18 published, 13 media); guest export byte-identical to Git (94/94); re-run idempotency bug fixed in PPY-16a680 (#136).

right_now_summary: The import and byte-diff checks passed, and the re-run metadata bug was fixed in PPY-16a680.
